title: EU Finalizes CSRD Phase 2 Reporting Requirements for Mid-Cap Companies
content: The European Union has finalized Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) requirements extending mandatory ESG disclosure to mid-cap listed companies starting next fiscal year. Companies must report Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions alongside biodiversity and water impact metrics.

title: India's BRSR Core Framework Expands to 1,000 Listed Entities
content: SEBI has expanded the Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting (BRSR) Core framework, requiring assurance on ESG disclosures from the top 1,000 listed companies by market capitalization, focusing on carbon emissions, water usage, and waste management.

title: Local Football League Announces New Season Schedule
content: The regional football association released its fixture list for the upcoming season, with matches starting next month across twelve participating clubs.

title: New Carbon Border Tax Mechanism Enters Force for Steel and Cement Imports
content: A new carbon border adjustment mechanism now applies tariffs on imported steel and cement based on embedded carbon emissions, aiming to prevent carbon leakage and support domestic decarbonization efforts in hard-to-abate sectors.

title: Tech Company Launches New Smartphone Model
content: A major electronics manufacturer unveiled its latest smartphone featuring an improved camera system and faster processor, available in stores starting next week.
